        lower = row["lower"]
        upper = row["upper"]

            continue

            value = float(value) / 1000
            lower = float(lower) / 1000
            upper = float(upper) / 1000

        if (chip_id, test_item, retest) in chips:
            duplicates_ignored += 1
            continue

        if retest != "0":
            chips[(chip_id, test_item, retest)] = row
        else:
            chips[(chip_id, test_item, retest)] = row

    passed_chips = 0
    failed_chip_ids = set()

    for chip_id, results in chips.items():
        chip_passed = True

                break
            if not (float(chips[(chip_id, item, "0")]"lower"]) <= float(chips[(chip_id, item, "0")]"value"]) <= float(chips[(chip_id, item, "0")]"upper")):
                chip_passed = False
                break
        if chip_passed:
            passed_chips += 1
        else:
            failed_chip_ids.add(chip_id)

    yield_value = passed_chips / len(chips) if chips else 0.0

    return {

        "yield": yield_value,
        "failed_chip_ids": sorted(failed_chip_ids),
        "duplicates_ignored": duplicates_ignored,
        "missing_values": missing_values,
